keyFindings.description: Migration numbers collide with main: main has 0129_document_edit_notices (merged in #2137), and the INFRA-156 PR #2394 takes 0130_block_pointer_links. After any merge of main, pgmigrate.Load refuses two migrations that share version 129 (internal/pgmigrate/set.go:44-47,131-139), so the store fails before it applies anything (store/store.go:95-97). GitHub also reports the PR CONFLICTING (packages/envoy-client/CHANGELOG.md). Merge main forward, renumber 0129-0133 (up and census files) above main's highest, and update node_facts_migration_test.go:10-15 and the numbers quoted in packages/envoy/AGENTS.md, packages/envoy/CHANGELOG.md, packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/AGENTS.md, packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/README.md, the migrations' own comments and the PR body.

No CI has run for code 69d138bb. The implementer's push ended at 5ad3589f, whose message carries 'skip-checks: true' although the push also carried code (33cc1fec, 69d138bb), so GitHub started no workflow for it. The newest pull_request runs are at 9386d556 and were still queued at 10:53Z. The corrective push (the merge of main) must carry no trailer, so that CI runs on the code.

The census says dispatch-execute.ts is the only TypeScript reader of GraphNode. The dashboard also reads graph nodes through GraphReferences/GraphEdge (re-exported at packages/dispatch/web/src/api/types.ts:137-138): features/refs/ReferencedBy.tsx, RefPreview.tsx:344-357, reference-target.ts:262. None reads changed_at, and the new fields are optional, so nothing breaks. Add them as hits with a disposition. The Size line is also wrong: +3215/-219 at b3b3f1e0, not +3270/-225.

Cleanup, no behaviour change (fast-follow): RemovedBlockFacts returns a facts-only GraphNode with no Kind or ID, and api/references.go:141-160 copies the six facts out one by one. A RemovedBlockNode that builds the whole block node, as loadBlockNodes does, would remove the copy.

Cleanup, no behaviour change (fast-follow): the script branches on component_source in three places (the R12 case at 671, the if at 728, the inner if at 736). Moving the component-node read into a function called from the fixture and existing arms would leave one branch.
